title: Foundation Course (Class VI – VIII)
description: A strong base-building programme covering Assamese, English, Mathematics, Science and Social Science with weekly tests and activity-based learning.

title: Class IX – X (SEBA) Full Course
description: Complete HSLC preparation under SEBA with chapter-wise notes, previous year paper solving and monthly model examinations.

title: Class XI – XII Arts (AHSEC)
description: Assamese-medium higher secondary coaching for Arts stream with expert guidance in Economics, History, Political Science and Education.

title: Class XI – XII Commerce (AHSEC)
description: Complete Commerce coaching covering Accountancy, Business Studies, Economics and Finance with practical numerical problem sessions.

title: Computer Application Course
description: Hands-on computer training for every enrolled student — MS Office, typing in Assamese & English, internet safety and basic programming.

title: Olympiad & Competitive Exam Batch
description: Special batch for NSO, IMO, NSEJS and other Olympiads plus foundation for future competitive examinations.
